identity: source spatial generalization of known Gaussian-prior CFM and coordinate ablations; not new-method validation
outer_roles: reuse E30 four source median-coordinate quadrants and fixed128 queries/fold; entire held quadrant labels excluded from training/calibration/selection; existing source development, not blind city

training.selection: none; all arms/folds report; no outer-query tuning
training.source_prior: fit mean and covariance anew within each nonheld source fold, never full-source covariance
training.effective_input_note: same architecture but zero/removed-coordinate arms constrain input freedom

controls: whole nonheld source empirical law, exact and matchingM200
inner-selected existing Ridge residual satellite/all, exact finite-pool and matchingM200
metrics: source-defined temporal lag1/24/48 and weekday/weekend diagnostics
preprocessing_boundary: same historical source static encoder/features as E30, which may include held source images and static standardization; no strict train-images-only inductive claim. This is still source development, not independent-city confirmation.
resource_gate_before_candidate_spatial_r: For any proposed new candidate, require both business macroCRPS >=2% better than strongest same-information control and wins>=3/4 source regions before broad training-seed/target expansion. All failed arms retained. This resource gate does not establish statistical significance.
gate_applicability: known Gaussian-prior baseline is being characterized; passing is not novelty or cross-city proof
resources: one GPU only after fresh no-process/memory/utilization checks; no old queues, no repeated completed Gaussian-prior random-split fits
evaluation_gate: No outer query scoring before all 72 CFM forecasts plus required matched controls are sealed. Source-only control generation may follow CFM completion; no target scoring.
